interface.shortDescription: Check and adjust b4 on your router through its MCP server
interface.longDescription: Procedures for b4, the DPI-bypass and traffic-routing service on your router, through its built-in MCP server: connecting an AI app, troubleshooting, unblocking a site, routing through a VPN or SOCKS5, finding an app's hosts and writing a bug report.
